_comment: Every .json file that may be deployed as a public static asset (tracked and not matched by .assetsignore). Add a file here ON PURPOSE, with a reason. tests/asset_allowlist.test.js fails for any other deployable JSON. Raw fares, price histories and snapshots must never appear here (Addendum N, N6).

files.sparkfare_ranked_deals.json: board, route pages, /check, digest, newsletter (JFK daily, derived verdicts)
files.sparkfare_ranked_deals_other_origins.jso: board, route pages, /check, digest (other origins, derived verdicts)
files.sparkfare_hourly_ranked_deals.json: read by the Worker's data-freshness monitor
files.sparkfare_pto_window_prices.json: read by the /time-off pages and watch alerts
files.scripts/brand-baseline.json: tooling baseline read in CI; harmless, candidate to ignore later
files.scripts/brand-checks-baseline.json: tooling baseline read in CI; harmless, candidate to ignore later
files.scripts/brand-checks-baseline-dark.json: tooling baseline read in CI; harmless, candidate to ignore later
files.scripts/referral-copy-allowlist.json: copy-checker allowlist; harmless, candidate to ignore later
